name: Baine Bloodhoof
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Baine Bloodhoof guards his people and Mulgore. While Cairne leads from Thunder Bluff, Baine directs local defense against gnolls and outside threats.

sections.title: Son of the High Chieftain
sections.body: Baine Bloodhoof grew up traveling with his nomadic people, the son of Cairne. They settled in Mulgore’s grasslands, where centaur clans remained a threat. After the Third War, Khiragg’s warband captured Baine, and grief left Cairne nearly unable to lead the new settlements. Rexxar freed Baine from captivity. The rescue restored Cairne’s spirit, and the tauren stood with Thrall’s Horde against the invading Kul Tirans, securing their foothold on the continent.

sections.title: Guardian of Bloodhoof Village
sections.body: Baine lives among his kin in Bloodhoof Village rather than at the capital mesas. As Cairne grows older, Baine bears more responsibility for the people and represents the next generation of tauren leadership. He directs braves and visiting allies against Palemane gnolls that trouble the borders, and watches for outside influences that threaten Mulgore’s natural balance.

sections.title: Defending the Earth Mother
sections.body: Baine faces encroachers who give little thought to spiritual balance. In eastern Mulgore, the goblin Venture Company cuts into the sacred landscape. Dwarven prospectors from Bael Modan dig ancestral soil at the Bael'dun Digsite. Baine urges a firm but measured response: warn the miners and destroy their equipment instead of rushing into needless bloodshed. He says their violent digging hurts the spirits of the earth, but the miners refuse to listen.

faq.answer: Baine Bloodhoof is Cairne Bloodhoof’s only son. He oversees defense and tribal affairs in Bloodhoof Village, directing local braves and protecting Mulgore while his father rules from Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Where can Baine be found right now?
faq.answer: Baine is in Bloodhoof Village, in central Mulgore just south of Thunder Bluff. Near the town center, he organizes tasks for newly arrived adventurers.

faq.q: How was Baine rescued from the centaur?
faq.answer: After the Third War, Khiragg captured Baine, leaving Cairne in debilitating despair. Rexxar sought help from Bovan Windtotem’s outcasts, tracked the centaur to their encampment, slew Baine’s captors, and returned him safely to his father.

faq.q: What problems does Baine manage in Bloodhoof Village?
faq.answer: Baine coordinates efforts against Palemane gnolls harassing local herds. He also watches foreign intruders, including the goblin Venture Company and Alliance dwarven excavators disrupting the earth.

faq.q: What is Baine's stance on the Bael'dun dwarven digsite?
faq.answer: Baine believes the Bael'dun miners’ violent digging hurts the spirits of the earth and defiles the land. He sends travelers to seize and smash their tools, hoping to scare the miners away and show them that hollowing the land is no path to knowledge.

faq.q: Will Baine succeed Cairne as High Chieftain?
faq.answer: As Cairne’s son, Baine takes a greater role in leading the tauren as his father grows older. Many see him as the natural heir to the united tribes.

angles.text: Baine carries the honorable lineage of High Chieftain Cairne and the hope of the young tribes gathered across Mulgore’s plains.
Baine brings calm wisdom and quiet martial strength to Thrall’s Horde, guiding those who pass through central Mulgore.
Baine puts the spirits first. He sends travelers to silence dwarven machines and reckless miners before their digging further wounds the spirits of the earth.
